select m.* from tb_sub_image m
m.audit_status = 1
AND m.special_id = #{params.specialId}
AND m.image_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{params.imageCode},'%')
AND m.parent_image_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{params.parentImageCode},'%')
AND m.viscera_type = #{params.visceraType}
AND m.image_id in (select s.image_id from tb_slide s where s.is_delete = 0 and s.project_id = #{params.projectId} and s.group_id = #{params.groupId})
and date_format(m.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.accessTime.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(m.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.accessTime.endTime},'%y%m%d')
